formats.key: initializeDeposit((bytes4 version, bytes inputVector, bytes outputVector, bytes4 locktime) fundingTx, (uint32 fundingOutputIndex, bytes8 blindingFactor, bytes20 walletPubKeyHash, bytes20 refundPubKeyHash, bytes4 refundLocktime, address vault) reveal, address l2DepositOwner)
effects: No tokens or ETH move and no approval or state changes; the function is not payable and only emits DepositInitialized(fundingTx, reveal, l2DepositOwner, msg.sender).
An off-chain relayer picks up the event and reveals the Bitcoin deposit on L1, so tBTC minted from the BTC already sent on Bitcoin is later bridged to l2DepositOwner on L2.
The BTC amount being deposited and the refund terms (refundPubKeyHash, refundLocktime) come from the Bitcoin funding transaction and the reveal data. The L2 call only passes them along.
formats.shown: "Initialize L2 tBTC deposit", with the L2 deposit owner and the vault as addresses, plus the reveal values and the Bitcoin tx parts as raw hex.

findings.title: initializeDeposit has no interpolatedIntent naming who will receive the minted tBTC.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: "intent": "Initialize L2 tBTC deposit", and there is no interpolatedIntent. L2BitcoinDepositor.sol initializeDeposit emits l2DepositOwner, and that is the address tBTC is later bridged to.

findings.title: initializeDeposit: the BTC deposit amount is buried in the raw Bitcoin outputVector bytes.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field fundingTx.outputVector 'Bitcoin outputs' format raw, visible optional. In case 0 the screen shows 0x01a086010000000000220020..., which is a little-endian value of 100000 sats that no reader can decode.
findings.fix: No ERC-7730 format can parse Bitcoin varint/LE outputs; the amount cannot be shown until the spec supports it.

findings.title: initializeDeposit: the refund locktime is a little-endian bytes4 timestamp shown as raw hex.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json reveal.refundLocktime 'Refund locktime' format raw; case 0 shows 0x65f1d480. tBTC encodes it as a 4-byte little-endian Unix time, so the date format cannot render it.
findings.fix: Waits on a little-endian or bytes-to-date format in the spec.
